description: This file defines a reusable 'Panel' component for a LightningJS-based application. The component includes props for size, header, and elevation, and features visual styling such as rounded corners, shadows, and focus indication. It contains methods for focus management and handles focus navigation events.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the panel to show shadow and scaling effects.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus effects from the panel.
